description: Witness eval questions (owner: Sibi). Each question has one expected witness and a phrase from the fact that answers it. Used by witness.evaluate() and backend/scripts/metrics.py (witness accuracy and citation rate vs a no-retrieval baseline). Phrased like a crew member or mission planner would ask, not copied from the facts.

questions.question: How big are smoke particles from overheated spacecraft materials in microgravity?
Which materials make smoke that is too small for the ISS light-scattering smoke detector to see well?
questions.expected_fact_contains: Teflon and Kapton smoke particles were very small

questions.question: Does smoke get bigger the longer it travels before reaching a detector?
What happens to smoke particle size when there is no airflow, like inside a closed avionics box?
Can a two-moment detector tell smoke apart from large dust particles?
How clean is the air in the ISS cabin?
Does ripping open Velcro create particles that could set off a smoke alarm?
Does the P-Trak particle counter work in microgravity?
questions.expected_fact_contains: modified P-Trak works in low gravity

questions.question: What is the smallest particle the P-Trak can count?

Are enriched-oxygen spacecraft atmospheres a fire hazard according to the Burning Rate Emulator?
Can a droplet keep burning invisibly after the visible flame goes out?
